name: How do I choose the right location for a tiny home on my property?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right location for a tiny home on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right location for your tiny home involves considering several practical and regulatory factors. Assess factors like sun exposure for natural light and potential solar panels, proximity to existing utilities, accessibility for construction and future use, and maintaining privacy from your main residence and neighbors. Crucially, ensure the chosen spot complies with local setback requirements and zoning ordinances to avoid permitting issues. We can help evaluate your property for optimal placement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a tiny home location considering sun exposure, utility access, privacy, and most importantly, compliance with local setback rules and zoning ordinances for proper permitting.
